about: P2 round 3's next laptop request (STATE.md, Laptop requests 0, 2, 3 and 4), four jobs drafted in the lab queue's job format (lab/laptop/README.md) for the operator to copy into queues; not a queue itself. Commit: c30a75ecc07c5c30216d3cf8a3eae3d6fb873273 on branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (local; the operator bundles it from that checkout, as for a27b47e). Order on each system: its bring-up, then its records (the records use the bring-up's request sets). Untimed: no job reads a time of any program, and none is quiet-checked. Downloads during the jobs: the CMake FetchContent archives, each checked against its sha256 pin; RapidJSON v1.1.0 by git tag on Arch when the system has none (Pistache's CMake, as in round 2); Go modules checked against go.sum (GOPROXY=direct, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, caches under ~/lab/p2r3/go or C:\Users\alext\lab\p2r3\go); crates against Cargo.lock (cargo --locked, P4's CARGO_HOME); no toolchain is ever fetched (RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0). Needs: P2 Laptop request 1 on both systems (done 2026-10-24); on Arch round 2's instrumented libc++ at ~/opt/libcxx-msan-gcc (MSan). The records refuse to run on any host but the laptop (host name and CPU). No measured basis for any expected_s; the bases named are lower bounds.

jobs.note: builds in ~/lab/p2r3/build-<commit> and progs-<commit>, request sets in ~/lab/p2r3/sets (about 140 MB); stops at the first failed step (steps.txt); no measured basis: round 2's rbench ASan record on Arch, which builds the same external arms under a sanitizer, took 1,581 s
